subject: general
question: For how many days will the Ashtalakshmi Mahotsav be celebrated in December 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three days**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ashtalakshmi Mahotsav 2024** was a three-day cultural festival held from **December 6th to 8th, 2024**, at **Bharat Mandapam, Pragati Maidan, New Delhi**.
 
• This** inaugural event celebrated the rich cultural heritage** and economic potential of Northeast India's eight states—Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, and Tripura—collectively known as the 'Ashtalakshmi'. 
 
• 
 **Over 250 artisans and entrepreneurs** showcased handicrafts, handlooms, and agri-horticultural products, with a special focus on 34 Geographical Indication (GI)-tagged items
 
 
• 
 The fusion of contemporary design with traditional textiles, **showcasing Muga silk gowns and Eri silk stoles.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** first ever Ashtalakshmi Mahotsav aims to offer a dynamic stage** for showcasing Northeast India’s vibrant textile sector, tourism opportunities, traditional craftsmanship, and distinctive Geographical Indication (GI) tagged products.
 
• It will serve as a celebration of the region’s cultural wealth while focusing on its strategic importance in India’s future development.
 
• The festival has been conceptualized as an annual event that will continue to honor the diversity and cultural richness of Northeast India, propelling the region towards further economic advancement.
 
• The Mahotsav will also emphasize the significance of infrastructure development in Northeast India and its transformative impact.
 
• The region’s improved connectivity, industrial growth, and ongoing development in sectors like transport, energy, and digital infrastructure are poised to enhance its strategic role in India's growth story and open new opportunities for trade and business
